nodes.label: ADR 0144: FLAC decoded by GLUE itself; a big song gets the time it needs; a song given up on says so
nodes.rationale: GLUE decodes FLAC itself (RFC 9639), first in the analysis worker; reads 8MB at a time. Song time: 2 minutes or 1 second per MB. After 3 failed tries, a song is saved as failed with explanation, shown as 'Couldn't analyse', and retried when asked
